highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ships the new Graphite GPU backend, async pixel read-back, and a wave of managed-code performance improvements.
highlights_body: This release adds Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn — the next-generation Skia rendering engine. It also adds an async `RequestReadPixels` API, a new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` helper package, FreeType font support on Nano Server, and numerous zero-allocation performance wins across text shaping, color conversion, and data I/O.

bullets.lead: Skia upgraded to milestone m151 with multiple upstream bug-fix syncs
bullets.detail: The engine was updated to Skia m151, and several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability and correctness fixes were applied throughout the release cycle.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
bullets.detail: The new next-generation Skia GPU renderer (Graphite) is now accessible from C# via new backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling GPU-accelerated rendering on modern pipeline APIs.

bullets.lead: CPU raster regression from m151 restored
bullets.detail: `SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT` was re-enabled to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced by the m151 upgrade.

bullets.lead: WASM updated to Emscripten 5.0.6 with new exception-handling model
bullets.detail: WASM native builds now use Emscripten 5.0.6 with the new `exnref` exception-handling scheme, and static libraries for .NET 11 are included.

bullets.lead: Async `RequestReadPixels` added to `SKImage` and `SKSurface`
bullets.detail: A new backend-neutral `RequestReadPixels` method allows asynchronous pixel read-back from GPU surfaces without blocking the render thread.

bullets.lead: New `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package with Vulkan tests on Android and Linux
bullets.detail: A new helper NuGet package wires up SkiaSharp's Vulkan backend to Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings. Vulkan integration tests now run on Android and Linux CI.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: Nano Server, which lacks the Win32 GDI font stack, now falls back to FreeType for font loading and measurement.

bullets.lead: Containerized test coverage: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server
bullets.detail: New Docker-based CI legs exercise SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server, catching platform-specific issues early.

bullets.lead: Binding generation made deterministic across platforms
bullets.detail: The binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the host OS, removing spurious diffs in generated files during cross-platform development.

bullets.lead: Native use-after-free in `SKRegion.SpanIterator` fixed
bullets.detail: The underlying `SKRegion` was not kept alive during iteration, causing intermittent use-after-free crashes. The region is now rooted for the lifetime of the iterator.

bullets.lead: Native use-after-free in `SKPixmap.ExtractSubset` and `With*` fixed
bullets.detail: The pixel-data source object was not rooted across calls to `ExtractSubset` and the `With*` helper methods, leading to potential memory corruption.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in `SKImage.Create` failure path fixed
bullets.detail: When the native `sk_image_new_raster` call failed, the already-allocated CoTaskMem pixel buffer was never freed.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in `SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI)` fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was leaked when the optional `SKRectI` crop overload was used.

bullets.lead: Unnecessary `unsafe` modifier removed from `GRContextOptions`
bullets.detail: The `GRContextOptions` class carried an unneeded `unsafe` modifier that could trigger CA warnings in consumer projects.

bullets.lead: Solutions migrated from `.sln` to `.slnx` format
bullets.detail: All Visual Studio solution files have been converted to the new `.slnx` XML format, reducing merge conflicts and improving solution-load times.

bullets.lead: SKColor ↔ SKColorF conversion ported to managed math — no P/Invoke
bullets.detail: Color conversion between `SKColor` and `SKColorF` is now pure managed arithmetic, eliminating a per-call P/Invoke round-trip.

bullets.lead: SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply ported to managed integer math
bullets.detail: Single-value pre-/un-premultiply operations now run as managed integer math, removing P/Invoke overhead on the hot path.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimized; `ReadOnlySpan<char>` overloads added
bullets.detail: `SKColor.Parse` and `TryParse` now use `ReadOnlySpan<char>` internally and expose span overloads, enabling allocation-free parsing from string slices.

bullets.lead: Allocation-free HarfBuzz text shaping and tag parsing
bullets.detail: `Buffer.AddUtf8` uses a pooled UTF-8 encoder, SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans, and `Tag.Parse`/`SKFourByteTag.Parse` no longer allocate a temporary array per call.

bullets.lead: `SKData.SaveTo` and text-encoding hot paths optimized
bullets.detail: `SKData.SaveTo` now writes directly from native memory, `GetEncodedText` avoids an intermediate string allocation, `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` pre-sizes its lookup map, and `HandleDictionary` caches the skip-registration reflection check.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, and contributed Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM.
contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server, resolving a long-standing issue with font loading on Windows Server Core.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Fixed Windows native builds by initializing the MSVC environment once per build, improving build reliability.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate applied the final round of m151 upstream fixes, landed the WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 native libraries, fixed the CPU raster regression, resolved two use-after-free memory bugs, and closed out performance work on HarfBuzz and color conversion.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced the Graphite GPU backend bindings, async RequestReadPixels, the Silk.NET Vulkan package, containerized test infrastructure, SKColor span overloads, and the zero-copy SKShaper and SKData performance improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 updated the engine to Skia m151, added FreeType on Nano Server, migrated solutions to .slnx, ported SKColor conversion to managed math, and began the SKRegion and SKPixmap use-after-free fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release with performance improvements: `Buffer.AddUtf8(string)` is now allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encoder, and `Tag.Parse` no longer allocates a temporary array per call.
